items.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated 'Odyssey'
items.summary: xAI's Grok published seven minutes of an AI-generated Odyssey adaptation made with Wonder Studios, three months after Elon Musk promised a full film. TechCrunch's reviewer found the visuals competent but the dialogue stilted and the voiceover tedious.
items.whyItMatters: A reminder that AI-generated video is visually capable but still weak on dialogue and voice performance, so voice quality remains the differentiator for a tutor.

items.title: Apollo economist: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies
items.summary: Apollo Global Management's chief economist says non-tech companies have seen flat profit margins and productivity despite heavy AI spending. He argues AI lacks the judgment and accountability to drive real business growth.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing as a sign that buyers want measurable ROI, which favors a tutor with clear, demonstrable learning outcomes over novelty.
